verdict: THE UNIFIED ROBUST DETECTOR (② EXP-9): one data-driven instrument folds verdict + ABSTAIN + MIXTURE into the frontier detector. On a 9-case menu it (U1) returns confident correct verdicts on clean single-regime inputs (Kepler->regular, Lorenz->chaos, LHV->classical, singlet->contextual, relational geometry->gauge); (U2) flags a KAM mixed ensemble (Hénon-Heiles E=1/8) as MIXTURE with fraction-chaotic 0.42 instead of a single label; (U3) ABSTAINS on every underdetermined input (the SAME KAM ensemble short-integrated, a near-boundary Werner state at N=16, a 6-point distance matrix) -- with ZERO wrong confident verdicts anywhere. (U4) One instrument, all three outcome types, correct across the menu. The frontier detector now degrades honestly: it answers when it can, reports a distribution when regimes coexist, and says 'not enough data' otherwise.
